result.title: Sensitivity Analysis of Decision Rules in an Agent-Based Agro-Ecological Model
result.summary: Agent-based models are well-suited for modelling agro-ecological systems for decision-making, yet turning their simulations into actionable insight requires identifying which decisions actually drive the behaviours. In such a context, sensitivity analysis stumbles upon a structural feature of many complex systems: the parameters are not a flat vector but a decision tree in which many parameters appear only when a higher-level choice activates them. Classical global sensitivity analysis presupposes independent inputs over a fixed Cartesian product and is ill-posed on such a branched space and biased by construction. We instead treat the structure of the decisions as a first-class modelling object. Using advanced surrogate modelling techniques, we encode the crop-management itinerary of the high-resolution agro-ecological modelling platform MAELIA as a hierarchical design space featuring both categorical and numerical variables. We propose a novel dedicated method to analyse this kind of hierarchical space, a random-forest-supervised HSIC-ANOVA, which ranks main effects and interactions natively on the tree while placing rarely and always active decisions on an equal footing. We show how, when applied to simulation outputs such as nitrogen leaching, soil organic carbon variation, and yield predictions, it can deliver an interpretable, decision-oriented reading.

AI.brief_summary: 论文把农作物管理决策的层级化设计空间（参数并非扁平向量，而是仅在某高层选择激活时才出现的决策树）当作一等建模对象，提出随机森林监督的 HSIC-ANOVA 方法，在含类别与数值变量的分支空间上对 MAELIA 平台模拟输出（氮淋溶、有机碳变化、产量）做敏感性分析，排序主效应与交互作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「条件激活变量」上的方差分解与主效应—交互排序思路，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的贡献分配、以及变长深度条件下各步贡献的可比评价提供参考，但属跨领域类比，具体可迁移性需人工核查。
